end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying festivals and linking harvest festivals with the crop-ready season. Kavya gave examples of Baisakhi clothing, flowers and laddoos, and connected Pongal with a new rice crop. The month-and-season link for Baisakhi remained mixed up and was not corrected by the end. At home, ask Kavya to match three festivals with their month, season and one celebration detail.
